title: Signature parameter name followed by a documentation placeholder
summary: Documentation-style text naming the signature parameter with a placeholder instead of a value, in the form AWS itself prints.
rationale: A parameter named signature is not ground truth for a secret. The AWS signing page prints X-Amz-Signature with a calculated-signature placeholder; the parameter name is public and the placeholder was never issued.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. AWS documents the parameter name and prints it with a placeholder value in its own request example; no signature value is present.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
